method: Rows 1-14 of ~/codewatch-research/gaps/misses.tsv, in file order. The file held 14 missed cases (15 lines: a header plus 14 rows), all cve-pairs-php, no Python or JavaScript, and none had been noted by an earlier run. For each case I read the fix commit's message and full per-file diff (gh api repos/O/R/commits/SHA) and, where the diff did not show the source or the sink, the files at the fix commit's parent (gh api repos/O/R/contents/PATH?ref=PARENT, raw): chamilo's model.ajax.php, egroupware's Saml.php, TestLink's planUrgency.php and testPlanUrgency.class.php, Fork CMS's Search/Index.php and Engine/Header.php, fusionpbx's dialplan_detail_edit.php and call_centers/cmd.php, OpenEMR's portal/lib/download_template.php, Admidio's TableAccess.php, Session.php and common.php, AVideo's objects/Streamer.php, objects/Login.php and install/test.php, OSSN's dynamic.php, EspoCRM's Core/Utils/Language.php and Tools/LabelManager/LabelManager.php, Piwigo's admin/batch_manager.php, Wavelog's controllers/Oqrs.php, and MISP's ObjectsController.php and Lib/Tools/AttachmentTool.php. Fork CMS, Admidio and AVideo-Encoder were also downloaded as tarballs at the fix's parent to find the callers the diff does not show (SpoonFilter::getGetValue, new Session(), Login::run). Nothing was skipped: all 14 rows have a note. One case is unsure: CVE-2014-9470 (Fork CMS) encodes a canonical URL that Header::parseSeo also encodes at the parent, so only the entry point the fix changes is visible. CVE-2026-135258 (MISP) is unsure because the model method that passes a request attribute id into AttachmentTool::save is not in the diff.
